title: What you believe about wealth
header_line: My analysis of one book on habits. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What do you secretly believe wealth does to a person?

I said that I have a complicated relationship with money: growing up I associated it with important and necessary things, but I also hold a belief that money must be secondary to everything else. I said I have to change that belief.

I said that when I tell people they are not multimillionaires, it is because something blocks them: deep down we associate wealth with negative things, so we feel the two things cannot coexist, a famous writer who gives and a multimillionaire.

I said that being wealthy does not mean you are a bad person or buy boats and cars. I said wealth is defined by who you are and your service to others, and that many of us let other people define what wealthy is.
Write what wealthy means to you, in your own words, and what you would do with it for others.
Education, not advice. This is not financial advice.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write what you were told about money growing up.
Write what you believe about wealthy people.
Write what you would do with more money for others.
Write your own definition of wealthy.
Write what you will stop letting others define.

check.q: What did I say blocks many people from wealth?
How did I say wealth is defined?
choices: By who you are and your service to others

check.q: What did I say many of us do?
choices: Let others define what wealthy is

recap: Find your hidden beliefs about money. Define wealthy yourself.
